a.lede: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.
a.title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says

b.lede: Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer with Anthropic.
b.title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
